C:\mingw64\bin\g++.exe -g -Wl,--whole-archive CMakeFiles\mi_app.dir/objects.a -Wl,--no-whole-archive -o mi_app.exe -Wl,--out-implib,libmi_app.dll.a -Wl,--major-image-version,0,--minor-image-version,0 @CMakeFiles\mi_app.dir\linkLibs.rsp
